answer: Key the bond to a hardware root so one machine cannot back a thousand seats, then vest the reward across 100 epochs. Every submission carries a fresh nonce and is hashed, which catches a copy even when the body is reformatted. A vault of bonds sits behind each seat and a farm must own the hardware to release it. The trade-off is honest: this also prices out real operators on shared infrastructure, and a small inlet of agents pays the same zenith of entry cost as a large one.
